name: Coastline Detection Benchmark Dataset
description: Evaluates algorithms' ability to detect coastlines in satellite imagery using the provided labeled benchmark data and evaluation protocol.
reputation: A specialized remote-sensing benchmark for coastline extraction that is referenced in the earth‑observation community for evaluating segmentation algorithms; moderate adoption among coastal-mapping researchers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; challenges include varying sensor resolutions, tidal and seasonal coastline changes, annotation ambiguities, and label noise — cross-sensor and cross-region generalization can be limited.
